summary: 봄(4월 하순~5월 초순)과 가을(10월 하순~11월 초순)에 서해의 섬을 해마다 적은 수가 지나가는 나그네새로, 국내에서는 2000년에 처음 기록되었다. 노랑눈썹솔새와 매우 비슷해 지나치기 쉬우며, 나뭇가지 사이를 쉴 새 없이 옮겨 다니며 나무 아래층과 덤불에서도 곤충을 잡는다. 국내를 지나는 무리는 중국 중부에서 번식하는 아종(mandellii)이고, 인도 북동부·인도차이나 북부·중국 남서부에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Hume's Leaf Warbler (Phylloscopus humei), adult in fresh autumn plumage (sexes alike), as seen on Korean islands on passage: crown dull greyish-olive with at most a faint paler central stripe; long buffy-white supercilium and a dark eye-stripe; upperparts greyish-olive, less green than in Yellow-browed Warbler; wings dark with one clear whitish-buff wing-bar on the greater coverts, a shorter and fainter second bar on the median coverts, and whitish tertial edges; underparts dull off-white. Bill fine, mostly dark with only a little pale at the base of the lower mandible; dark eye; legs dark brown.
art.pose: flitting through the outer twigs of a small tree, flicking its wings while gleaning insects
art.scene: coastal woodland edge on a Korean offshore island in late October, yellowing leaves and soft autumn light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, autumn, side view among outer twigs, wings slightly flicked: diffuse pale crown stripe, long supercilium buff at the front, dark eye-stripe, dull greyish-olive upperparts, one clear pale bar on the greater coverts and a faint shorter bar on the median coverts, grey-centred tertials with pale fringes, whitish underparts, dark legs

adult, head detail in side view: dull greyish crown with a diffuse paler central stripe, long supercilium buff in front of the eye, distinct dark eye-stripe through the lores, pale cheeks, dark eye, fine bill with a dark lower mandible
art.build: Tiny, active leaf warbler, much smaller than a tree sparrow, with a rounded head, slim body and short tail. Bill very fine and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs thin, dark brown. Constantly flicks its wings while gleaning insects from the outer twigs of trees.
avoid: Do not paint bright green upperparts and two bold whitish-yellow wing-bars; that is Yellow-browed Warbler (Phylloscopus inornatus).
Do not paint a yellow crown stripe or a pale yellow rump (Pallas's Leaf Warbler).
Do not paint pale pinkish legs or a mostly pale lower mandible.
